original_evidence.summary: Independent exact-subject plan review approves P1-P9 for the real single-repository CLI documentation/evidence pilot. No blocking standards or specification finding was identified. This is plan review approval only; it is not knowledge recognition or an impact disposition.
assessment: Independently resolved HEAD c391de78e5f9a6720d154cbbbbf544c1f8f28fce and validated the frozen plan-authority/v1 subject. Both adopted artifacts (the pilot plan and automatically adopted docs/product-foundations.md) match their current worktree and committed artifact digests. All nine commitments are retained in the frozen subject.

P1-P3 define documentation and retained CLI evidence scope, use native governance writes and exact independent review, and preserve approved-commitment versus implementation-coverage semantics. No source, policy or remote-settings changes are authorized.

P4-P5 keep a proposal candidate without authority until the selected human owner recognizes its exact native returned digest. Actual returned body/receipt, acquisition observation, agent adoption and checks remain distinct. Nonmatching and empty-set behavior is evaluated without advancing unrelated historical Changes.

P6 correctly treats this session as recovery of pre-pilot records only, since no v1 supply existed at entry. A genuine later replacement executor, concrete handoff, owner session authorization and real approved documentation action remain required; a subprocess is explicitly insufficient.

P7 preserves v1 and reserves exact future v2 recognition and exact impact disposition to the owner-recognized process. It does not preselect continuation, automatically revoke approval, release commitments through knowledge correction or permit self-reported verified execution.

P8 isolates malformed/conflicting/corrupt evidence and dependency experiments from the real ledger. Missing, failed, skipped or unknown-issuer conclusions cannot become approval; challenge does not release a constraint.

P9 retains native verification, assessment, exact code review and attestation obligations while distinguishing installation, policy, observable acquisition, real use and traceability. Pending owner/session stages must remain pending; this review cannot support marking the full pilot complete before those stages actually occur.

The normative product architecture remains authoritative. The bounded single-repository CLI exercise discloses cross-repository sharing, universal interception, complete recall, semantic understanding and long-term effectiveness limits without narrowing product obligations.

validation.independently_performed: Read current AGENTS.md, frozen plan and adopted foundation artifact, normative product architecture, knowledge/procedure docs, concrete v1 proposal and owner-preparation record, both recognition contracts, review import/validation implementation. Ran read-only subject validation and committed/worktree artifact digest comparisons. No repository or ledger mutations; only this external conclusion artifact was written.
validation.not_performed: No runtime acceptance, full test suite, remote GitHub revalidation or knowledge operation execution was performed by this reviewer. These remain implementation/acceptance evidence, not established by plan review.

original_evidence.limitations: Owner confirmation is the visible current-chat response and supplied task context, not authenticated identity evidence. Entry-state merge/base/activation facts are implementation-agent retained evidence, not independently remote-revalidated here. Future v2 content/disposition is intentionally not yet selected; it must receive its own exact owner conclusion. Approval covers only the named current frozen plan subject and does not approve implementation, authorize source fixes, recognize v1/v2 or claim completed replacement-session acceptance.
